{{Quote|We'll have to take him back to the base. I'm sure Admiral Farsteller will want to say a few words&hellip;|Leia Organa, upon believing that Luke Skywalker had died|<ref name="RPG" />}}
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Farsteller''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] believed Farsteller would want to say a few words at the funeral for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], when she and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] believed Skywalker had perished due to lack of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Skywalker had instead entered a [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trance]], forestalling the need for a funeral or a eulogy from Farsteller.<ref name="RPG" />
